title: ROOM COST PREVIEW
description: Decoration mode now previews the full material cost of a room plan, including missing rugs, wall trim, lamp variants, and the suspiciously necessary premium fern.
consequence: The room learns to name its missing pieces.

title: CRAFTING CART AUTOFILL
description: Workshop plans now show owned materials, safe substitutes, and exact leftover counts before opening the supply shop for anything the player already has in a chest.
consequence: The shopping list stops pretending to be a quest.

title: SYNERGY AURA PACKS
description: Card shop offers now glow when they might fit the current deck, using vague combo halos, rotating keywords, and a small oracle sparkle over the expensive picks.
consequence: The shop starts winking in tooltips.

title: HEIRLOOM BARTER PRICES
description: The village market now lists seed prices through seasonal favor marks, neighbor IOUs, soil stamps, and a handwritten exchange chart pinned behind the pumpkin crate.
consequence: The price tag starts speaking farmer.
